Dear Kara, 

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today. 

I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Check all the wires are connected as they should be. And please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to see whether it is above 22V. If the voltage is normal, please check whether the power led on the control board is ON. If the two above are fine please do the test 2. If the power led is off, check the fuse whether it was burnt out and replace the fuse if necessary. There is a backup fuse packed within the user manual pack.

2. Disconnect all accessories from the control board first (just leave the power source and the arm). And disable the photocell function by turning the dip switch #3 off, even though you didn't install the photocell.. Then erase all remotes codes from the control board and reprogram them to have a try. If it fails, please immediately short the push button terminals (4# and 5#) to check whether the opener can work, referring to the attached video. 


3. If the step 2 doesn't help, please check the motor. Connect the red & black wires of the arm to the DC 24V power source directly, the motor should run, and then exchange the polarity of the wires, the motor should run in the opposite direction. If the motor runs in both directions, the motor itself is good. Please connect the black & red wires back to the control board and check step 4.

4. Disconnect the BLUE, GREEN & YELLOW wires of the faulty arm from the control board, use two jumper wires to short the ULT, COM & DLT terminals to which the wires were connected, and then press the remote to see if the arm could extend and retract. If it could move in both directions, then the limit switch is defective. When you do this test, you could press the remote in time in case the arm extends too much.


Please let me know the result one by one. 

And also please share me the order # of the gate opener and keypad for further assistance. 

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Joyce
TOPENS Customer Service Team

If there is no luck, please do the following tests. 
Please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to seewhether it is above 22V. If the voltage is normal, please do the following steps. 

Erase all remotes codes from the control board. Then reprogram them to have a try. If it fails, please immediately short the push button terminals (4# and 5#) to check whether the opener can work, referring to the attached video. 

If the problem still persists, please check the motor. Connect the red & black wires of the arm to the DC 24V power source directly, the motor should run, and then exchange the polarity of the wires, the motor should run in the opposite direction. If the motor runs in both directions, the motor itself is good. 

Please connect the red & black wire of the arm back to control board. Disconnect the BLUE, GREEN & YELLOW wires of the faulty arm from the control board, use two jumper wires to short the ULT, COM & DLT terminals to which the wires were connected, and then press the remote to see if the arm could extend and retract. If it could move in both directions, then the limit switch is defective. When you do this test, you could press the remote in time in case the arm extends too much.

If the gate opener can work normally after disconnecting the accessories, please do the tests as follows. 
Reconnect the accessories back one by one to see which accessory is related to the problem.
If it is the ET24 electric lock causing the problem, please test the working current of ET24. Connect the ET24 lock, the UPS01 (the LOAD terminals), and a multimeter in series with reference the following diagram. Kindly note turn the knob of the multimeter to test DC current. In a normal case, the working current through the ET24 is no more than 3 Amps. 



And further detect whether the voltage of the LOAD terminals of the UPS01 will drop sharply when connecting the ET24 to the LOAD terminals with reference to the following diagram. In this case, please turn the knob of the multimeter to test DC voltage. 


Looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Dear Jim,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today. 

I am going to talk about the distinctions among A8132, AD8, AT1202 and PW802 gate openers from the following aspects.

1.Arm
All of their motors share the same power (80W). However, A8132, AD8 and PW802 are equipped with A8 arm, while AT1202 is using AT12 arm, both of which are different in the physical appearance.

2.Control board
A8132, AD8 and PW802 shares the same energy-saving control board, while AT1202 is with the standard control board, which is more energy consuming because of the digital display.

3.Power modes
A8132: A8132 is equipped with the TOPENS UPS01 uninterrupted power supply. With it, A8132 gate opener can be powered by AC electricity directly. And also, you can use battery as the main / back-up power source. The 20W solar panel is also supported. The all-purpose UPS01 adapter can power the system, as well as efficiently charge battery, and securely regulate solar charging current.
AD8: The batteries are used as the main power source and it is packed with an adapter used to charge the batteries. If you would like to use AC electricity as the power source, you need to purchase a DPS180-U power supply or UPS01 power supply. If you also would like to apply solar panels, you require an UPS01 or TCS3 solar controller.
PW802: Equipped with the DPS180-U power supply, PW802 gate opener can be powered by 100-240VAC electricity directly. You can also use the extra 24V battery and 20W solar panel to power this system. But, kindly note that the DPS180-U can NOT connect with battery or solar panel. You can try UPS01 adapter (NOT Incl.) to charge battery as well as securely regulate solar charging current.
AT1202: AT1202 includes built-in transformer, and can be powered by AC electricity directly. The battery ONLY can be used as back-up power source. If you want to apply solar panels, a solar charge controller (NOT incl.) is a must.

To summarize, since you only use AC electricity as the power source, you can choose PW802 and AT1202, which share the same price but PW802 is more energy-saving.

PW802:
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07DFFHFVP

AT1202:
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07XQ69685

As for your second concern, the AUTO CLOSE FEATURE is that the gate will close automatically after the time you set once you enable the AUTO CLOSE function and set the AUTO CLOSE time on the control board. In this case, you need not push any button to close the gate.

With regard to the ranges of TC188 keypad and TC173 wireless push button, the max. range of TC188 is 35 feet, while the max. range of the TC173 is 65 feet. If you want to extend their range, you can employ our ERM12 external receiver, whose max. range is 98 feet. Optionally, you can also replace the antenna on the control board with a higher-power antenna.

Dear Elisabeth, 

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today. 

I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1.  Reconfirm the open and closed positions with reference to the following instruction. 
If your gate is installed as pull-to-open (viewed from the inside of your property)
The open position is determined by the gate bracket. Please retract the moving-rod fully and leave the gate at the desired open position so as to confirm the position of the gate bracket.
The closed position is adjusted by the limit switch B (far from the motor). Please reconfirm the desired closed position through sliding the limit switch B inwards or outwards.


If your gate is installed as push-to-open (viewed from the inside of your property)
The closed position is determined by the gate brakcet. Please retract the moving-rod fully and leave the gate at the desired closed position so as to confirm the position of the gate bracket.
The open position is adjusted by the limit switch B (far from the motor). Please reconfirm the desired open position through sliding the limit switch B inwards or outwards.


2. After ensuring the open and closed positions of the gate, pleasedetect the voltage of the +BAT- (11#, 12#) terminals on the control board after pressing the remote to see whether the voltage can stay at almost 24V (above 22V). If the voltage drops too much, the problem should be with the power source. If the voltage is fine, please do the following tests.

3. Please power off the system first (disconnect the power source from the +BAT- terminals). And turn the FORCE potentiometer all the way clockwise to increase the stall force, and turn the SOFT STOP potentiometer all the way counter-clockwise to decrease the soft stop period. Then turn on the power and operate the gate opener to run for a complete opening & closing cycle. See whether the gate will open and close all the way in the next opening and closing cycle.



3. If the adjustments in step 3 don't help, please take down the arm from the gate and press the remote to see if the arm can extend and retract properly each time. If the arm can run normally in this case, the arm is fine, please let me know the weight and length of your gate, and whether the gate can be opened & closed freely 3.3 feet (one meter) away from the gate hinge .

Please let me know the result of every step. If the problem persists, videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board are appreciated for further judgement. Please directly send the video to my E-mail via the attachment. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive. Thanks for your understanding and cooperation.

By the way, the TC102 has been shipped. Could you please share me a screenshot of the email about the delivery you have received? 

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Joyce
